newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares advance, slight gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares advance, slight gains seen.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged up on Monday by the close and dealers said moderate gains were looming on the horizon but nothing bullish.
The official list index crept up 7.59 points to 954.90 and the broader Litin A index rose by 13.42 points to 1,866.39.
Central market trade was 620,000 litas and block trades turned over 507,000 litas. Turnover on the secondary T-bill market was over ten million litas.

"Shares are finally starting to rise a bit, if only because they are so cheap at the moment...there are some good buys on the market right now, and investors are starting to recognise this," said one dealer.
"Prices should gain slowly but nothing spectacular," he added.
Leading bank Vilniaus Bank, which posted an interim profit which almost matched its figure for all of 1997, rose to 245 litas from 243 in trade of 133,000 litas and dealers said it had room to rise.
"It should move up in the near futute...I think 255 litas or 260 litas wouldn't be high for Vilniaus Bank at the moment," said one broker.
Rival Hermis Bank inched up to 216 litas from 215 in trade of just over 96,000 litas and dealers said it would probably stay in that range for awhile.
Rokishkis Cheese inched up to 43 litas from 42.95.
